baseline_models.mechanism: Recognition becomes an owned avowal: the confessors attach the culpable act to themselves, and the sequential fa immediately converts that admission into a verdict of removal while naming a durable bond with an actively kindled blaze.

activation_trace.role: Its admission and yielding sense makes recognition a self-binding confession.
Its culpable-act sense supplies the confessed liability, which the possessive marks as theirs.
Its distance and expulsion image turns the curse into exclusion from a viable relation or place.
Its sustained companionship image makes the relation to the Blaze settled rather than momentary.
Its kindling and flaming image makes the destination an active combustion rather than a neutral location.

changed_reading.before: They admit a sin and are cursed as people of the Fire.
changed_reading.after: Their own avowal immediately ratifies exclusion while identifying them as durably bound to an actively kindled Blaze.

baseline_models.mechanism: The curse can retain the ordinary distance sense while also carrying a material register: pulverizing and wearing-away operate upon people whose companionship denotes prolonged attachment to a continually inflamed process.

activation_trace.role: Its crushing and fragmentation image supplies a destructive material action inside the curse.
Its wearing and decay image extends the verdict from one impact into attrition.
Its continuing accompaniment supplies the duration through which attrition works.
Its ongoing ignition supplies the energetic process to which the companions remain attached.

changed_reading.before: Suhqan is only a formula of banishment and the Blaze only a destination.
changed_reading.after: The formula also evokes prolonged crushing and wearing within a settled bond to an ever-kindled process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening test is defined as making a condition manifest through intentional work. The focus confession is therefore not an isolated late utterance but the test's terminal self-disclosure: the tested agents finally name as their own the accountable result their conduct has exposed.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes the condition appear frames confession as the endpoint of disclosure.
Intentional action supplies the accountable material that the focus gathers into an owned offense.
Avowal and submission turn manifested knowledge into the agents' own testimony.
The offense image names the adverse result as culpability rather than mere failure.

structural_cues: The purpose clause in 67:2 places disclosure by testing before the judgment scene.
The singular offense with a plural possessive in 67:11 compresses the exposed outcome into a jointly owned liability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing-as-manifestation, intentional work, and confession; I supply the arrow test to exposed conduct to self-admission. A live alternative is that the confession is only post-verdict speech and not the designed terminus of the test.

changed_reading.before: The confession is a detached admission made after punishment arrives.
changed_reading.after: The confession is the test's terminal disclosure, in which intentional conduct becomes an outcome the tested agents must finally own.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated return of sight offers iterative recognition; denial interrupts it, and the condemned later identify absent receptive hearing and restraining reason as the missed route. Iʿtiraf then becomes the belated closing of that recognition loop: evidence is finally acknowledged only after it can no longer redirect the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Return and restoration supplies the repeated reopening of an opportunity to recognize.
Inner discernment makes the repeated gaze a cognitive trial, not only optical inspection.
Return after a prior turn supplies iteration and the possibility of correction.
Contradiction of truth supplies the active blockage that prevents earlier recognition from settling.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the receptive act they say was missing.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance identifies the arresting function they failed to use.
Recognition after an identifying mark makes confession the eventual reading of accumulated evidence.
Avowal converts the eventual recognition into explicit self-implication.

structural_cues: 67:3-4 repeats the command to return the gaze and explicitly adds a second turn.
67:9 records denial, while 67:10 uses a counterfactual to name hearing and reasoning as the missed prevention.
The focus follows with fa, making confession the next event in the sequence but not a repair of the earlier refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies iterative return, discernment, denial, receptive hearing, restraint, and eventual recognition; I supply the temporal arrow from refused iterations to too-late closure. The alternative is a looser list of faculties and acts without one recognition loop.

changed_reading.before: The confession is a fresh moment of moral clarity.
changed_reading.after: The confession is the too-late completion of a recognition process repeatedly offered, actively blocked, and retrospectively understood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Blaze boils and expresses heated rage while successive human groups enter it. Against that process, aṣhab marks not passive occupancy but a stabilized collective attachment to an active, repeatedly fed field of combustion.

activation_trace.role: Boiling and surging makes the Blaze an active process rather than a static container.
Rage figured as heat and eruption couples affective intensity to the thermal process.
The human-group image supplies serial cohorts that become the collective named in the focus.
Persistent companionship converts serial entry into an enduring relation.
Kindling and flaming names the active process with which the group remains associated.

structural_cues: 67:7 gives the fire audible and kinetic predicates; 67:8 continues with near-rupture from rage.
The repeated whenever-clause in 67:8 serializes entry by groups before 67:11 names one companion class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boiling, heat-rage, recurring groups, companionship, and kindling; I infer that repeated entry stabilizes into cohabitation with a process. A live alternative is that the fire's agency is rhetorical personification and aṣhab remains only a conventional class label.

changed_reading.before: Companions of the Blaze means people located in a fiery place.
changed_reading.after: It names a collective durably coupled to a boiling, raging, repeatedly fed process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the speakers themselves formulate the category they say receptive hearing or reason would have prevented: companions of the Blaze. The focus repeats that category after their confession, so the curse sounds like a ratified self-classification rather than an externally introduced label.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the exact relation the speakers first place inside their own counterfactual.
The kindled Blaze supplies the exact destination label uttered by the speakers themselves.
Confession turns their preceding counterfactual diagnosis into an owned present classification.
Repeated companionship reissues their own relational label as the verdict.
Repeated kindling preserves the lexical identity of the self-spoken and ratified class name.

structural_cues: The phrase companions of the Blaze closes 67:10 and recurs at the close of 67:11.
The voice moves from first-person counterfactual self-description to third-person curse after confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate lexical repetition and the shift in voice; I infer that the second phrase ratifies the first as self-classification. The alternative is formulaic repetition that links verses but carries no special dialogic force.

changed_reading.before: The final phrase is a new narrator-imposed designation.
changed_reading.after: The final phrase ratifies the condemned speakers' own diagnosis, so confession includes recognition of the class to which they now belong.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later equivalence of concealed and public speech before comprehensive knowledge changes the function of confession. It does not inform an ignorant judge; it exteriorizes and binds the speakers to a condition already known down to its interior.

activation_trace.role: Concealment in the interior supplies the information channel that remains unavailable to ordinary observers.
Public declaration supplies the outward channel into which confession moves the speakers' condition.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower makes hidden and public speech equally available to judgment.
Knowledge of the report and its interior removes any need for confession as fact-transfer.
Avowal now functions as self-implication and submission rather than supplying unknown evidence.
The offense remains the object publicly owned even though its interior reality was already known.

structural_cues: 67:13 coordinates concealing and proclaiming speech, then gives both the same knowing addressee.
The rhetorical question in 67:14 grounds that knowledge in creation and interior expertise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, proclamation, disclosed knowledge, interior expertise, and avowal; I infer that confession changes the speaker's standing rather than the knower's information. The alternative is that 67:13-14 addresses a separate epistemic point with no backward effect on 67:11.

changed_reading.before: Confession reports a previously unspoken fact to the authority judging them.
changed_reading.after: Confession publicly binds the speakers to an already known inward reality; its force is self-implication, not information transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between face-down movement and upright movement on a straight path supplies an orientational frame for suhqan. Distance is not only remoteness from a place; it can be heard as exclusion from the alignment in which directed movement remains possible.

activation_trace.role: Overturning onto the face supplies disorientation and failed forward movement.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies the viable orientation from which exclusion can be measured.
Upright completeness supplies the posture that makes directed walking possible.
The straight-road image supplies a relational axis for near, far, upright, and overturned movement.
Distance and removal become exclusion from the path's usable orientation.

structural_cues: 67:22 repeats walking on both sides of a sharp face-down versus upright comparison.
The focus curse is a directional noun placed between confession and the class label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overturning, guidance, uprightness, a straight road, and distance; I infer that the distance is relational to right orientation. The alternative is that suhqan remains a general eschatological banishment with no path resonance.

changed_reading.before: Suhqan means only that the condemned are sent far away.
changed_reading.after: Suhqan also marks loss of usable orientation: they are removed from the upright, directed relation in which a path can still be walked.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because later nearness is not an explicit antonym gloss of suhqan. It remains anchored in the focus distance branch and is activated by the packet's approach branch; downstream prose should render it as a spatial resonance, not a lexical equation or exclusive interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Distance and expulsion supply the outward vector borne by the curse.
An event surging into nearness supplies the opposing inward vector that sharpens expulsion.

changed_reading.before: The curse expresses a static state of being far away.
changed_reading.after: The surah permits crossed vectors: what they denied drives near while the confessors are driven away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because dhanb in the focus directly denotes culpable sin. It remains valid as a secondary overlay because the packet explicitly preserves the tail or after-end branch and later supplies a route contrast; downstream prose must retain ordinary culpability and qualify the route reading as an image of consequence, not a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: The direct sin and offense sense keeps the reading morally and grammatically anchored.
The tail and after-end image overlays the offense with the consequence trailing from it.
Face-down overturning supplies the failed mode of travel whose end is now owned.
The straight road supplies the contrasting trajectory that makes a trailing outcome legible.

changed_reading.before: They acknowledge guilt as an isolated past offense.
changed_reading.after: They acknowledge the offense together with its tail: the owned after-end of a face-down course rather than an act detached from its trajectory.

strongest_changes: Confession became the terminal self-disclosure of the test rather than a detached post-punishment statement.
Repeated seeing, hearing, reasoning, and denial made iʿtiraf the too-late closure of a refused recognition loop.
The repeated companions-of-the-Blaze phrase made the final curse a ratification of the speakers' own classification.
Later hidden/public speech and comprehensive knowledge shifted confession from information transfer to self-implication.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah's compact sequence joins an owned singular offense, immediate consequence, and a class label already uttered by the condemned; the branch inventories then keep legal admission, cognitive recognition, spatial exclusion, material attrition, and durable companionship simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the test-to-confession sequence is a designed causal arc or only a broad thematic frame remains inferential.
The material crushing and wearing senses of suhqan may be audible overlays while distance remains primary.
The route, tail, and near/far activations are packet-anchored but should remain explicitly exploratory.
